issue.title: Consolidate the duplicate console-script resolvers (chop runner, mobile gateway, service host) into one shared helper
issue.description: Tech-debt follow-up from the service-host console-script resolution tale: four near-identical PATH/interpreter-sibling resolvers now exist.

task_type_fields.proposal:
Fold the duplicate "resolve a bare console-script name" logic into one shared helper so a
future plugin-script fix lands in one place instead of four.

Today the same PATH-then-interpreter-sibling fallback exists as separate implementations:

- `src/sase/axe/chop_script_runner.py` `discover_chop_script` (search dirs -> interpreter
  sibling -> PATH; returns `Path | None`)
- `src/sase/integrations/mobile_gateway.py` `_resolve_gateway_command` (PATH ->
  `_python_environment_command`, with Rust-target fallbacks)
- `src/sase/service/executable.py` `resolve_launcher_argv` (PATH -> interpreter sibling,
  returns argv plus a diagnostic; added by plan
  `202609/service_host_console_script_resolution.md`)
- sase-telegram `src/sase_telegram/executables.py` `resolve_console_script` (a separate
  repo, so it needs a released core API or a deliberate keep-separate decision)

Note the lookup order differs: `discover_chop_script` is sibling-first, the gateway and
service host are PATH-first. Any consolidation must either preserve each caller's order or
make the change of order explicit and safe (PATH-first is purely additive; sibling-first
can change which executable a name resolves to).

Acceptance sketch: one helper in a neutral module with injected `which_fn` / interpreter
(the style of `sase/uv_tool/detect.py`), each in-repo caller migrated with its existing
tests passing unchanged, and a recorded decision on the sase-telegram copy.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope:
The service-host fix (telegram_receiver crash-looping on `[Errno 2] ... 'sase_job_tg_inbound'`)
had to stay a small, reviewable tale. The resolvers have different signatures
(`search_dirs`, Rust-target fallbacks, argv vs `Path` results, differing lookup order), so
folding them together in that change would have made it unreviewable and risked changing
which executable already-working launchers resolve to. The plan explicitly directed filing
this as a follow-up.

payload.description: Same failure class (bare console-script names at spawn seams); its sase-telegram fix touches the resolve_console_script copy this task would consolidate
